Pitch: I hold a line. You pay me by the fight, not by the hour, and I swear on my shield I don't ask which hold you've robbed.
Renewal: One more fight on the books and my shield's my own again. Want it for longer, or do we shake hands here?

Pitch: Undefeated in three pit towns and two the Concord shut down. Champions cost champion money.
Renewal: Last bout on the card, boss. Champions get re-signed or they get scouted. Your call.

Pitch: Coin up front and I'll ride wherever the wagons roll. I've dodged worse than tithe-wardens.
Renewal: Contract's nearly spent. I'm easy either way, but I'd ride on with you if the purse is there.

Pitch: My circles still answer me, even this close to a Still. That is rarer than you think, and priced to match.
Renewal: My circles run dry after one more working. Renew the pact, or let it lapse cleanly. Lapsed pacts never sour.

Pitch: I set bones and sit with the Hollow until they stop wandering, and I don't charge extra for screaming. Contract's by the battle.
Renewal: One battle left on my ledger. I've grown used to patching this lot. Shall we write another page?

Pitch: Fastest legs in the underspire. I run orders, I run checkpoints, and I run the price up if you dawdle.
Renewal: Last run on this contract. Fast legs don't stay unclaimed long, so make me an offer or I'm gone.
